description: ABAC policies for AI dataset access control

policies.name: Block Student Access to Confidential Data
policies.description: Students are explicitly denied access to confidential AI datasets.

policies.name: Block Remote Restricted Data Access
policies.description: Restricted datasets cannot be accessed from remote locations.

policies.name: Researcher AI Dataset Read
policies.description: Allows AI researchers to read confidential AI datasets for research purposes.

policies.name: Student Public Dataset Read
policies.description: Allows students to read public AI datasets for academic purposes.

policies.name: Admin Restricted Dataset Access
policies.description: Allows authorized administrators to read restricted datasets.

policies.name: Data Scientist Internal Dataset Access
policies.description: Allows data scientists to read internal AI datasets for model development.

policies.name: Security Team Audit Access
policies.description: Allows security personnel to read audit and security datasets.

policies.name: Researcher Write Access
policies.description: Allows approved researchers to write to internal research datasets.
